Sure! Here’s a customizable 7‑day “Paris Highlights” itinerary that balances culture, cuisine, and relaxation. Feel free to tweak it based on your interests, budget, or travel dates. --- ## Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle or Orly. Take the RER B or a taxi to your hotel/hostel. Check‑in and freshen up. | | Afternoon | Stroll along the Seine, grab a croissant from **Ladurée** or **Poilâne**, and enjoy a casual lunch at a café near your accommodation. | | Evening | Sunset walk to the Eiffel Tower. Light show at 20:00 (if you’re there early enough). Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (reservation recommended) or a nearby bistro like **Café Constant**. | *Tip:* If you’re staying near the Marais, consider a welcome dinner at **Chez Janou** for classic French fare. --- ## Day 2 – Classic Landmarks | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Louvre Museum (arrive early to avoid crowds). Focus on the Denon Wing (Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo). | | Lunch | Picnic in the Tuileries Garden—pick up baguette, cheese, and wine from **Boulangerie Poilâne**. | | Afternoon | Walk to **Musée d’Orsay** (Impressionist masterpieces). Then stroll through the Latin Quarter. | | Evening | Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (romantic, historic setting). Optional night cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches). | --- ## Day 3 – Montmartre & Artistic Vibes | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Sacré‑Coeur Basilica (stunning city view). Explore Place du Tertre (artists’ square). | | Lunch | Try **La Maison Rose** or **Le Consulat** for classic French dishes. | | Afternoon | Visit the **Espace Dalí** or the **Montmartre Museum**. Wander down Rue Lepic for vintage shops. | | Evening | Attend a cabaret show at **Moulin Rouge** or a smaller venue like **Le Lapin Agile**. | --- ## Day 4 – Palace & Gardens | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Versailles Palace tour (book skip‑the‑line tickets). Explore Hall of Mirrors, Royal Apartments. | | Lunch | Picnic in the gardens or dine at **La Petite Venise** inside the palace grounds. | | Afternoon | Return to Paris; relax in the Luxembourg Gardens. | | Evening | Casual dinner at **Le Petit Cler** (market street bistro). | --- ## Day 5 – Modern & Contemporary | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Centre Pompidou (modern art). | | Lunch | Grab a sandwich from **Le Pain Quotidien** or try the food court at **Galeries Lafayette**. | | Afternoon | Shopping in the 9th arrondissement or explore the Canal Saint‑Martin area. | | Evening | Dinner at **Septime** (reservations needed) or **Frenchie** for a trendy experience. | --- ## Day 6 – Hidden Gems & Relaxation | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Explore the **Canal Saint‑Martin** neighborhood—cafés, boutiques, and street art. | | Lunch | Eat at **Café Charlot** or **Le Comptoir du Relais**. | | Afternoon | Visit the **Catacombs** (pre‑book tickets). | | Evening | Sunset at the **Pont Alexandre III**. Dinner at **L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (Michelin‑starred). | --- ## Day 7 – Departure / Last‑Minute Exploration | Time | Activity | |------|----------| | Morning | Quick visit to Notre-Dame Cathedral (outside only, interior closed due to restoration). | | Lunch | Final meal at **Bouillon Chartier** (budget‑friendly, historic). | | Afternoon | Souvenir shopping at **Printemps** or **Le Bon Marché**. | | Evening | Depart for the airport. | --- ### Practical Tips | Category | Recommendation | |----------|----------------| | **Accommodation** | *Mid‑range*: Hotel Le Six (Latin Quarter), Hôtel Henriette (Marais).
*Luxury*: Four Seasons George V, Ritz Paris.
*Budget*: Generator Paris (Marais), Hôtel des Arts (Saint‑Germain). | | **Transport** | Purchase a **Paris Visite pass** (valid for unlimited metro/bus/RER rides). Consider a **Navigo Week Pass** if you’ll stay >7 days. | | **Dining** | Book reservations for popular restaurants (especially Michelin‑starred). Use apps like **OpenTable** or **LaFourchette**. | | **Tickets** | Pre‑purchase skip‑the‑line tickets for major attractions (Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Versailles, Catacombs). | | **Language** | Learn basic French phrases; most places accept credit cards. | | **Safety** | Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded areas. Avoid carrying large amounts of cash. | --- Feel free to let me know if you’d like a different focus (e.g., culinary tour, art lovers, family-friendly, luxury, or budget options), and I can tailor the itinerary accordingly!
